outcome: Concentration of cyclosporine metabolites in colostrum
Estimated mean daily dose of cyclosporine for breastfed infant
Estimated mean daily dose of cyclosporine metabolites for breastfed infant
cohort: The participants were seven post-transplant mothers who were breastfeeding while on immunosuppression.
finding: The study found a low transfer of cyclosporine and its metabolites into the colostrum during the first two days postpartum.
